game_title: Flowchart Lab · Sum from 1 to n
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields, fields of drifting embers: the ember mage must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of sulfur crystals is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields: fields of drifting embers
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Read n. Add all whole numbers from 1 through n, then display the total. For n = 0, display 0. Test dataset 9: {'n': 0}; {'n': 14}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ember Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the lava bridge using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The lava bridge reached with actions_used <= 13.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the lava bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
